description: FINRA Reg SHO daily short-sale volume time series for one symbol — up to 30 trading days ending at `end_date` (default: most recent published day). Each day carries short_volume, short_exempt_volume, total_volume and short_ratio summed across every consolidated-NMS reporting facility, so the daily totals match FINRA's consolidated CNMS figures. Use it to see how a symbol's short-sale share of volume moved over recent sessions. Zero-rated: costs 0 credits.

end_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD; defaults to most recent published day

name: short_volume_history
